intro: NXTutors has no city tuition-jobs page in Jammu and Kashmir yet, so tutors in Srinagar, Jammu, Anantnag, Baramulla and other towns start from this page. Write your town and the localities you can reach for home lessons. When a family asks for a tutor at home, the request goes to the nearest suitable tutors before the search widens, so your base matters. Online lessons are matched by subject, class and board rather than place, which means a tutor in Kathua or Kupwara can be shortlisted for a student anywhere in India.

Students in Jammu and Kashmir may study under JKBOSE, CBSE or another board, so list each board you teach along with the medium. Take syllabus and exam details from the board's own site rather than from secondhand sources. For every request, NXTutors puts forward two or three tutors; the family sees the fee you set before a free first class, and if the match does not work out later, they can switch without paying for it. Tutors in the Jammu division and the Kashmir division follow the same steps; just name your own town and the classes you prefer to take.

faqs: Where do I check JKBOSE syllabus details?
On the board's own site, jkbose.nic.in. It did not load when we prepared this page, so we have not summarised it here; check it directly before a demo rather than relying on secondhand notes.
Can I teach online from Srinagar or Jammu?

You can. Whether a student in Pune or Patna is offered your profile depends on the subject, class and board you list, never on your pin code. Home visits are different: there, families in the Valley or the Jammu region get the tutors living closest to them.
What happens after a family sends a request?

The family describes the student's class, board and subject. From that, NXTutors picks two or three profiles, with tutors close to the family's home ahead of those further away. The parent can see what you charge, has a first class with you at no cost, and may later change tutor without paying anything for the change.

It is not. Joining involves an identity step only: a single-use code sent to your phone or email, then a government photo ID that a team member looks at before anyone can see your profile. The How we verify tutors page lays out each step.
Being listed needs a paid tutor plan; the pricing page at /pricing compares them. What you charge a J&K family per lesson is a separate matter that you decide.
